items.title: 61539_Butter Jackson oral history interview
items.q: And even in Duke's band I played bass. When Wendell would be out, I could play in his place.

ctx.x: You know, in Duke's band I heard these arrangements, right? I heard everybody's part. I used to listen to the saxophone section and I knew their parts by listening to it because I was -- you know, I'd get so wrapped up
in these things and it was phenomenal. And even in Duke's band I played bass. When Wendell would be out, I could play in his place.
Yeah, tell us a little bit about Wendell Marshall. He was Jimmy Blanton's cousin, wasn't he?
